assessment: This study documents a key role for osteocyte-derived Cx43 hemichannels in the anabolic response of bone to mechanical stimulation, using transgenic mouse models and a Cx43 (M1) antibody. The studies shed new light on the molecular mechanisms that transduce mechanical loading into new bone formation, and identify Cx43 as an actionable target.
